query:
WITH ins AS (
                INSERT INTO iam_rate_limit_events (bucket, key, occurred_at)
                VALUES ($1, $2, NOW())
                RETURNING 1
            )
            SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins) + COUNT(*) AS "count!"
            FROM iam_rate_limit_events
            WHERE bucket = $1
              AND key = $2
              AND occurred_at > $3
